mapper.select: SELECT product_id, category_name, manufacturer, model_number, product_name, description, photo, price, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at FROM product_master WHERE model_number = #{modelNumber} AND start_date = #{startDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_master ( category_name, manufacturer, model_number, product_name, description, photo, price, start_date, end_date ) VALUES ( #{categoryName}, #{manufacturer}, #{modelNumber}, #{productName}, #{description}, #{photo}, #{price}, #{startDate}, #{endDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_master SET category_name = #{categoryName}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, product_name = #{productName}, description = #{description}, photo = #{photo}, price = #{price}, end_date = #{endDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE model_number = #{modelNumber} AND start_date = #{startDate}
